words: Which big animal has a long trunk?
Think of the animal with a trunk and big ears.
Which animal has fins and swims in water?
Look for an animal with fins, not legs.
Which farm bird has a long neck and honks?
Its call sounds like honk, honk.
Which shape is often used to show love?
It has two rounded bumps at the top.
You follow a dotted line with your pencil. What do you do?
Keep your pencil on the guide line.
You pretend to be a character and show a story with actions. What do you do?
Use your body to show the story.
What small round thing fastens a shirt?
It goes through a small hole in your shirt.
Which instrument has strings and is played with a bow?
Hold it under your chin and move the bow.
Which large fruit is green outside and often red inside with black seeds?
You can eat a juicy slice of this fruit.
Which wild animal often has reddish fur and a bushy tail?
Think of the animal with pointed ears and a bushy tail.
What long soft thread can be used to knit a scarf?
It is often wound into a ball.
Which animal looks like a horse with black and white stripes?
Look for black and white stripes.
What do we call a woman who rules a kingdom?
Which piece of jewellery do you wear on a finger?
It is a small circle for your finger.
What bright star lights our sky in the daytime?
It gives Earth light and warmth.
Which big cat has orange fur and dark stripes?
Think of a striped wild cat.
Which machine has a screen and can run programs?
You can use it with a keyboard and mouse.
What do you wear on your wrist to tell the time?
Look at your wrist to check the time.
Which toy goes down and up on a string?
It spins and returns up its string.
Which fastener has two rows of teeth and a small sliding pull?
You pull it up to close a jacket.
Hold up just your index finger. What are you showing?
Which long curved fruit has a peel and is often yellow when ripe?
Peel its skin before eating the soft fruit.
These sweet baked treats can have icing and birthday candles. What are they?
These small baked treats are often round and crunchy. What are they?
A hen lays these in a nest. What are they?
These juicy round foods are often red and used to make ketchup. What are they?
They are juicy and have small seeds inside.
Which woven container can hold food for a picnic?
It often has a handle for carrying.
buổi dã ngoại có ăn ngoài trời
You eat a packed meal outdoors on a blanket. What is this called?
Think of eating outdoors with your family.
These sandwiches have a patty inside a round bun. What are they?
Look for a patty between two halves of a bun.
These frozen sweet treats may come in cones. What are they?
They melt when they get warm.
These small colourful sweets are shaped like beans. What are they?
They are bean-shaped sweets, not vegetables.
Which small round fruits grow together in a bunch?
Look for lots of little fruits on one stem.
Which small crawling animal can later become a butterfly?
It eats leaves before changing into a butterfly.
A toy is made from several pieces. What do we call those pieces?
Several of these make one whole toy.
Which tiny six-legged insect lives in a colony and may visit a picnic?
It has six legs and two antennae.
These tiny six-legged insects live in colonies and may visit a picnic. What are they?
They often walk one after another.
Which container has a narrow neck and can hold a drink?
You can pour a drink from its neck.
Which piece of jewellery do you wear around your neck?
What small flat covering can lie on the floor or by a door?
You may wipe your feet on it.
ở trên và tiếp xúc với bề mặt
The ball touches the top of the box. Which word tells where it is?
It rests on the top surface.
Which building can a family live in?
It may have a roof, windows and a front door.
The ant is next to the bottle. Which word means next to?
These wax sticks have wicks that can be lit. What are they?
Birthday cakes sometimes have them. Do not touch a flame.
Which plant has a woody trunk and branches?
Look for a trunk, branches and leaves.
The ball is below the table. Which word tells where it is?
It is lower than the table.
These spicy sausage slices can go on pizza. What does the lesson call them?
Think of little round sausage slices on a pizza.
What is a space inside a house, with walls and usually a door?
A bedroom is one kind of this.
These long buns hold sausages. What are they?
Think of a sausage inside a long bun.
In a story, who uses spells and may carry a wand?
Which sweet is carried on a little stick?
Hold the stick while you lick the sweet.
In a story, a spell makes a hat disappear. What is this called?
It happens with a spell in a make-believe story.
Which small red fruit has little seeds on its outside?
It often has a green leafy top.
What do you wear on your head?
It can cover the top of your head.
Which yellow citrus fruit tastes sour?
You can use its juice to make lemonade.
Which thin rubber toy gets bigger when filled with air?
You can blow air into it.
These thin rubber toys get bigger when filled with air. What are they?
They are often used to decorate a party.
What clear liquid do we drink when we are thirsty?
We also use it to wash our hands.
Which small round berry is blue or dark purple when ripe?
Look for a little blue berry.
What do you wear in front of your eyes to help you see clearly?
Two lenses sit in a frame.
What picture shows places and helps you find the way?
It can show roads, rivers and towns.
những hạt đậu thần trong truyện
In a story, these beans grow in an amazing way after a spell. What are they?
These are special beans in a make-believe story.
Which round fruit has fuzzy skin and a large hard stone inside?
Its skin feels a little furry.
What is the thick woody main stem of a tree called?
The branches grow from this main stem.
Which farm animal has a snout and says oink?
Which flower can have a sweet smell and prickles on its stem?
It is often given as a flower gift.
Which long soft animal has no legs and lives in soil?
Which animal has a very long neck and spots?
It can reach leaves high in trees.
Which large furry animal has strong paws and a short tail?
Think of the animal that a teddy toy looks like.
Which small seed is often cooked as food and can grow into a bean plant?
It is a seed you can cook or plant.
Which pet barks and wags its tail?
It leaves ink on the paper.
